answer: Work-slot deposit burn turns each slot into a losable bet. An identity escrows 90 units for 3 epochs per slot; a Raven jury of 7, drawn by VRF verifies work in the Grove queue. Honest work returns the deposit after 3 epochs. Fake work burns all 90 units, logged in the Sable ledger; a second offence freezes all deposits for 20 epochs. A forger with 1,000 fakes escrows 90,000 units; at 30% detection the burn is 27,000 per round, while one slot pays at most 12 — break-even is a 13% catch rate. The jury can't be gamed, so forgery loses 27,000 per round on a 90,000 outlay.
